Question: As salamo aliqum.mufti sahab i am 21 years old a computer science student.sir i have a bad habbit of severe mastrubating.please tell me that is it a sin?or in islam it is prohibited?or there ie no such thing in islam?how can i remove from it?now i cant marry .give me answer with reference of quran and hadith. Answer ID: 9490 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2142/1969=D/1429) Yes, it is a major sin; it is strictly prohibited in Islam. You should strive to guard your eyes and heart from bad views and bad thoughts. You should lower your eyes immediately if you happen to see. You should keep yourself busy in other work when bad imaginations come to your mind in idle time. Why can not you marry? If you are feeling weakness, then you should consult any expert hakim . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
